$comment: Refusal codes of the external access programme and the texts for a person (identical sign-in screens, /mcp refusals as text). A code is {code, where, http?, ascii?, text, text_ru}: text is the English text, the default; text_ru is the Russian interface language; the placeholders ({support}, {program}) are the same in both. Format /2: text and text_ru. The generators and readers take text; text_ru only for the Russian interface.
where: gateway — the internal gateway and the admin API; admin-plane — the admin listener; edge-auth, edge-mcp — the edge; relay — the bridge; authcheck — the sign-in check.
Sections keyed by x-stage; a section is edited on its own. A code is unique across the whole file.
Each section is on its own line after an empty one: edits of neighboring sections merge without conflicts.

codes.text: Cannot switch on: the service this setting turns on runs in user mode or has not answered for a long time. Outside access is switched on only after the services run in containers
codes.text_ru: Нельзя включить: служба, которую включает эта настройка, работает в пользовательском режиме или давно не отвечает. Внешний доступ включается только после перевода служб на контейнеры

sections.$comment: Admin plane. Refusals of administrator sign-in by GUID, role and anchors share one text, admin_login_denied; the exact code (admin_guid_*, admin_role_missing, admin_not_in_anchors) is only in the log (audit-codes.json).
